title: 16-to-4 priority encoder (chained when…else over 16 one-hot inputs)
problemDescription: 16-to-4 one-hot-to-binary encoder. Reference uses chained `when…else` over all 16 one-hot patterns. TB exhaustively sweeps x ∈ [0,65535] at 2ns each; bench duration caps at 256ns (128 transitions) to keep simulation tractable while still covering the meaningful one-hot patterns.
